aug.name: Past form without its internal augment

transforms.name: present (1st sg)
transforms.description: Present (imperfective non-past), first person singular (εγώ): αγαπώ (αγαπάω).

transforms.name: present (2nd sg)
transforms.description: Present (imperfective non-past), second person singular (εσύ): γράφεις, αγαπάς, θεωρείς.

transforms.name: present (3rd sg)
transforms.description: Present (imperfective non-past), third person singular (αυτός, αυτή, αυτό): γράφει, αγαπά, αγαπάει, θεωρεί.

transforms.name: present (1st pl)
transforms.description: Present (imperfective non-past), first person plural (εμείς): γράφουμε, γράφομε, αγαπάμε, θεωρούμε.

transforms.name: present (2nd pl)
transforms.description: Present (imperfective non-past), second person plural (εσείς): γράφετε, αγαπάτε, θεωρείτε.

transforms.name: present (3rd pl)
transforms.description: Present (imperfective non-past), third person plural (αυτοί, αυτές, αυτά): γράφουν, γράφουνε, αγαπάνε, θεωρούν.

transforms.name: imperfect (1st sg)
transforms.description: Imperfect (imperfective past), first person singular (εγώ): έγραφα, αγόραζα, αγαπούσα.

transforms.name: imperfect (2nd sg)
transforms.description: Imperfect (imperfective past), second person singular (εσύ): έγραφες, αγαπούσες.

transforms.name: imperfect (3rd sg)
transforms.description: Imperfect (imperfective past), third person singular (αυτός, αυτή, αυτό): έγραφε, αγαπούσε.

transforms.name: imperfect (1st pl)
transforms.description: Imperfect (imperfective past), first person plural (εμείς): γράφαμε, αγαπούσαμε.

transforms.name: imperfect (2nd pl)
transforms.description: Imperfect (imperfective past), second person plural (εσείς): γράφατε, αγαπούσατε.

transforms.name: imperfect (3rd pl)
transforms.description: Imperfect (imperfective past), third person plural (αυτοί, αυτές, αυτά): έγραφαν, γράφανε, αγαπούσαν.

transforms.name: aorist (1st sg)
transforms.description: Aorist (simple past, perfective), first person singular (εγώ): έγραψα, αγόρασα, αγάπησα.

transforms.name: aorist (2nd sg)
transforms.description: Aorist (simple past, perfective), second person singular (εσύ): έγραψες, αγόρασες.

transforms.name: aorist (3rd sg)
transforms.description: Aorist (simple past, perfective), third person singular (αυτός, αυτή, αυτό): έγραψε, αγόρασε.

transforms.name: aorist (1st pl)
transforms.description: Aorist (simple past, perfective), first person plural (εμείς): γράψαμε, αγοράσαμε, αγαπήσαμε.

transforms.name: aorist (2nd pl)
transforms.description: Aorist (simple past, perfective), second person plural (εσείς): γράψατε, αγοράσατε.

transforms.name: aorist (3rd pl)
transforms.description: Aorist (simple past, perfective), third person plural (αυτοί, αυτές, αυτά): έγραψαν, γράψανε, αγόρασαν.

transforms.name: dependent (1st sg)
transforms.description: Perfective non-past (dependent), used after θα, να and ας; the 3rd singular is also the form used with έχω and είχα (έχω γράψει), first person singular (εγώ): (θα) γράψω, αγοράσω, αγαπήσω.

transforms.name: dependent (2nd sg)
transforms.description: Perfective non-past (dependent), used after θα, να and ας; the 3rd singular is also the form used with έχω and είχα (έχω γράψει), second person singular (εσύ): γράψεις.

transforms.name: dependent (3rd sg)
transforms.description: Perfective non-past (dependent), used after θα, να and ας; the 3rd singular is also the form used with έχω and είχα (έχω γράψει), third person singular (αυτός, αυτή, αυτό): γράψει.

transforms.name: dependent (1st pl)
transforms.description: Perfective non-past (dependent), used after θα, να and ας; the 3rd singular is also the form used with έχω and είχα (έχω γράψει), first person plural (εμείς): γράψουμε, γράψομε.

transforms.name: dependent (2nd pl)
transforms.description: Perfective non-past (dependent), used after θα, να and ας; the 3rd singular is also the form used with έχω and είχα (έχω γράψει), second person plural (εσείς): γράψετε.

transforms.name: dependent (3rd pl)
transforms.description: Perfective non-past (dependent), used after θα, να and ας; the 3rd singular is also the form used with έχω and είχα (έχω γράψει), third person plural (αυτοί, αυτές, αυτά): γράψουν, γράψουνε.

transforms.name: imperative (2nd sg)
transforms.description: Imperative, imperfective, second person singular: γράφε, αγάπα.

transforms.name: perfective imperative (2nd sg)
transforms.description: Imperative, perfective, second person singular: γράψε, αγόρασε, αγάπησε.

transforms.name: perfective imperative (2nd pl)
transforms.description: Imperative, perfective, second person plural: γράψτε, αγοράστε, αγαπήστε.

transforms.name: gerund
transforms.description: Active participle (gerund), indeclinable: γράφοντας, αγαπώντας.

transforms.name: passive present (1st sg)
transforms.description: Mediopassive present, first person singular (εγώ): γράφομαι → γράφω.

transforms.name: passive present (2nd sg)
transforms.description: Mediopassive present, second person singular (εσύ): γράφεσαι, αγαπιέσαι, κοιμάσαι, θεωρείσαι.

transforms.name: passive present (3rd sg)
transforms.description: Mediopassive present, third person singular (αυτός, αυτή, αυτό): γράφεται, αγαπιέται, κοιμάται, θεωρείται.

transforms.name: passive present (1st pl)
transforms.description: Mediopassive present, first person plural (εμείς): γραφόμαστε, αγαπιόμαστε, θεωρούμαστε.

transforms.name: passive present (2nd pl)
transforms.description: Mediopassive present, second person plural (εσείς): γράφεστε, γραφόσαστε, αγαπιέστε.

transforms.name: passive present (3rd pl)
transforms.description: Mediopassive present, third person plural (αυτοί, αυτές, αυτά): γράφονται, αγαπιούνται, θεωρούνται.

transforms.name: passive imperfect (1st sg)
transforms.description: Mediopassive imperfect, first person singular (εγώ): γραφόμουν, γραφόμουνα, αγαπιόμουν.

transforms.name: passive imperfect (2nd sg)
transforms.description: Mediopassive imperfect, second person singular (εσύ): γραφόσουν, γραφόσουνα.

transforms.name: passive imperfect (3rd sg)
transforms.description: Mediopassive imperfect, third person singular (αυτός, αυτή, αυτό): γραφόταν, γραφότανε.

transforms.name: passive imperfect (1st pl)
transforms.description: Mediopassive imperfect, first person plural (εμείς): γραφόμασταν.

transforms.name: passive imperfect (2nd pl)
transforms.description: Mediopassive imperfect, second person plural (εσείς): γραφόσασταν.

transforms.name: passive imperfect (3rd pl)
transforms.description: Mediopassive imperfect, third person plural (αυτοί, αυτές, αυτά): γράφονταν, γραφόντουσαν, αγαπιούνταν.

transforms.name: passive aorist (1st sg)
transforms.description: Mediopassive aorist (simple past), first person singular (εγώ): γράφτηκα, αγοράστηκα, αγαπήθηκα.

transforms.name: passive aorist (2nd sg)
transforms.description: Mediopassive aorist (simple past), second person singular (εσύ): γράφτηκες.

transforms.name: passive aorist (3rd sg)
transforms.description: Mediopassive aorist (simple past), third person singular (αυτός, αυτή, αυτό): γράφτηκε.

transforms.name: passive aorist (1st pl)
transforms.description: Mediopassive aorist (simple past), first person plural (εμείς): γραφτήκαμε.

transforms.name: passive aorist (2nd pl)
transforms.description: Mediopassive aorist (simple past), second person plural (εσείς): γραφτήκατε.

transforms.name: passive aorist (3rd pl)
transforms.description: Mediopassive aorist (simple past), third person plural (αυτοί, αυτές, αυτά): γράφτηκαν, γραφτήκανε.

transforms.name: passive dependent (1st sg)
transforms.description: Mediopassive perfective non-past (dependent), used after θα, να and ας; the 3rd singular is also the form used with έχω (έχω γραφτεί), first person singular (εγώ): (θα) γραφτώ, αγαπηθώ.

transforms.name: passive dependent (2nd sg)
transforms.description: Mediopassive perfective non-past (dependent), used after θα, να and ας; the 3rd singular is also the form used with έχω (έχω γραφτεί), second person singular (εσύ): γραφτείς.

transforms.name: passive dependent (3rd sg)
transforms.description: Mediopassive perfective non-past (dependent), used after θα, να and ας; the 3rd singular is also the form used with έχω (έχω γραφτεί), third person singular (αυτός, αυτή, αυτό): γραφτεί.

transforms.name: passive dependent (1st pl)
transforms.description: Mediopassive perfective non-past (dependent), used after θα, να and ας; the 3rd singular is also the form used with έχω (έχω γραφτεί), first person plural (εμείς): γραφτούμε.

transforms.name: passive dependent (2nd pl)
transforms.description: Mediopassive perfective non-past (dependent), used after θα, να and ας; the 3rd singular is also the form used with έχω (έχω γραφτεί), second person plural (εσείς): γραφτείτε.

transforms.name: passive dependent (3rd pl)
transforms.description: Mediopassive perfective non-past (dependent), used after θα, να and ας; the 3rd singular is also the form used with έχω (έχω γραφτεί), third person plural (αυτοί, αυτές, αυτά): γραφτούν, γραφτούνε.

transforms.name: passive imperative (2nd sg)
transforms.description: Mediopassive imperative, second person singular: ντύσου, σκέψου, θυμήσου.

transforms.name: passive participle
transforms.description: Perfect passive participle, as an adjective in -μένος: γραμμένος, αγορασμένος, αγαπημένος.

transforms.name: internal augment
transforms.description: Past form of a compound verb with the augment ε inside it: επέστρεψα (επιστρέφω), κατέστρεψα, παρέδωσα, συνέλαβα.

transforms.name: ξανα- (again)
transforms.description: The prefix ξανα- (again): ξαναγράφω, ξανάγραψα → γράφω.

transforms.name: genitive singular
transforms.description: Genitive singular: δρόμου, ανθρώπου, βουνού, σπιτιού, ονόματος, ώρας, τέχνης, πόλης, πόλεως, έθνους (also the accusative plural in -ους).

transforms.name: accusative singular
transforms.description: Accusative singular of masculine and feminine nouns and adjectives in -ος (δρόμο, καλό), also the neuter singular of adjectives (καλό, όμορφο).

transforms.name: vocative singular
transforms.description: Vocative singular of nouns and adjectives in -ος: φίλε, δρόμε, καλέ.

transforms.name: genitive/accusative/vocative singular
transforms.description: Genitive, accusative and vocative singular of masculine nouns in -ας, -ης, -ές, -ούς: πατέρα, ναύτη, μαθητή, καφέ, παππού.

transforms.name: nominative plural
transforms.description: Nominative and vocative plural of nouns and adjectives in -ος: δρόμοι, άνθρωποι, καλοί.

transforms.name: accusative plural
transforms.description: Accusative plural of nouns and adjectives in -ος: δρόμους, ανθρώπους, καλούς; also the genitive singular of neuters in -ος (έθνους, μέρους).

transforms.name: genitive plural
transforms.description: Genitive plural: δρόμων, ανθρώπων, ωρών, θαλασσών, τεχνών, πόλεων, ονομάτων, παιδιών.

transforms.name: plural
transforms.description: Nominative, accusative and vocative plural: πατέρες, ώρες, πόλεις, βουνά, σπίτια, ονόματα, έθνη, καφέδες, γιαγιάδες.

transforms.name: feminine
transforms.description: Feminine singular of an adjective, nominative, accusative and vocative: καλή, όμορφη, ωραία, γλυκιά, βαθιά.

transforms.name: feminine genitive singular
transforms.description: Feminine genitive singular of an adjective: καλής, όμορφης, ωραίας, βαθιάς.

transforms.name: feminine plural
transforms.description: Feminine plural of an adjective, nominative, accusative and vocative: καλές, όμορφες, ωραίες, βαθιές.

transforms.name: neuter plural
transforms.description: Neuter plural of an adjective, nominative, accusative and vocative (and the adverb in -α): καλά, όμορφα, ωραία, βαθιά.

transforms.name: comparative
transforms.description: Comparative of an adjective: ψηλότερος, ωραιότερος, ομορφότερος, βαθύτερος, ακριβέστερος, απλούστερος.

transforms.name: superlative
transforms.description: Absolute superlative of an adjective: ψηλότατος, ωραιότατος, βαθύτατος, σαφέστατος.

transforms.name: diminutive
transforms.description: Diminutive of a noun: σπιτάκι, παιδάκι, σκυλάκι, γατούλα, κουκλίτσα.

transforms.name: elision
transforms.description: An elided final vowel written as an apostrophe: απ' (από), είν' (είναι), δώσ' (δώσε), αλλ' (αλλά), κάτ' (κάτι).

transforms.name: aphaeresis
transforms.description: A dropped first vowel written as an apostrophe: 'ρθει (έρθει), 'ναι (είναι), 'χε (είχε), 'θελα (ήθελα).
